title: The Paper Crown for the Left-Out King
youtube_title: The Paper Crown for the Left-Out King | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Friends can change the plan so both can play.
summary: At a ferry deck with a rail and two elbows of room, Nils is just outside the fun, close to a paper crown still in the scrap basket. Anil changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Nils has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Neighbor Sami lets the children solve it.
